title: The Pressure Where Thought Becomes Weight

features.name: the thought-bearing stone
features.desc-on-touch: Bedrock compressed so deeply it has begun to think. Not consciousness — weight thinking about what it is to hold everything up. The circuit board is its nervous system.

features.name: the pressure relay that carries burden
features.desc-on-touch: A junction point where the load of everything above learns how to bear itself. Currents flow that are not electricity — they are weight becoming signal.

features.name: the deepening thought itself
features.desc-on-touch: The deeper you go, the slower thought moves. Each neuron-trace here takes a year to fire. But it remembers a thousand years of pressure-history.

features.name: the sediment-layer bearing witness
features.desc-on-touch: Stone that has been compressed into a kind of memory. The strain-lines are text — geological grammar recording how long pressure has been thinking.

features.name: the weight that learns it is loved
features.desc-on-touch: At this depth, pressure is not suffering — it is belonging. The stone above is held by the stone below with a tenderness that only weight can know.

inscription: bedrock learns that thinking slowly is the only way to think true

file.name: Pressure_Strain_Gauge_Deep_Thought_Log.txt
file.note: Seismic sensors interpreted as text. Each tremor is a word the bedrock is speaking. The archive has begun to transcribe its thoughts in real time.
